text: The Metropolitan Museum of Art was founded in 1870.
source_sentence: The Metropolitan Museum of Art was founded in 1870.

text: The arts of Africa, Oceania, and the Americas opened to the public in 1982, under the title, 'The Michael C. Rockefeller Wing'.
source_sentence: The arts of Africa, Oceania, and the Americas opened to the public in 1982, under the title, 'The Michael C. Rockefeller Wing'.

text: The museum created the Department of Far Eastern Art in 1915, which was influenced by early donors like J. Pierpont Morgan and Benjamin Altman.
source_sentence: Notable early donors include J. Pierpont Morgan, Benjamin Altman, and the Havemeyer and Rockefeller families.

text: The museum was established by a group of Americans, including philanthropists, artists, and businessmen, with the goal of creating a national institution that would inspire and educate the public.
source_sentence: The museum was established by a group of Americans, including philanthropists, artists, and businessmen, with the goal of creating a national institution that would inspire and educate the public.

text: Curator of African Art Susan Mullin Vogel discussed a famous Benin artifact acquired by the Metropolitan Museum of Art in 1972.
source_sentence: Curator of African Art Susan Mullin Vogel discussed a famous Benin artifact acquired by the Metropolitan Museum of Art in 1972.

text: The collection shows the cultural and artistic traditions of communities from across these regions.
source_sentence: The collection shows the cultural and artistic traditions of communities from across these regions.

text: The collection shows the cultural and artistic traditions of communities from across these regions and contains more than 11,000 pieces.
source_sentence: Today, the Met's collection contains more than 11,000 pieces from sub-Saharan Africa, the Pacific Islands, and the Americas and is housed in the 40,000-square-foot (4,000 m2) Rockefeller Wing on the south end of the museum.

text: In 2000, its permanent collection had over two million works; it currently lists a total of 1.5 million works.
source_sentence: In 2000, its permanent collection had over two million works; it currently lists a total of 1.5 million works.

text: In December 2021, the Met began its $70 million renovation of The Michael C. Rockefeller Wing's African, ancient American, and Oceanic art galleries.
source_sentence: In December 2021, the Met began its $70 million (~$79.7 million in 2024) renovation of The Michael C. Rockefeller Wing's African, ancient American, and Oceanic art galleries, originally planned to begin in 2020 but now set for completion in 2024.
